raw.rationale: AVL-292 (spebrutinib) is a covalent BTK inhibitor whose viability effects in adherent solid-tumor PRISM lines are expected to be largely non-selective, since BTK dependency is mainly restricted to B-cell malignancies; only lineages with possible off-target YES1/SRC-family or BTK-related dependencies might show weak selective killing. Published PRISM/screening evidence does not support strong lineage-selective cytotoxicity at 2.5 µM, so probabilities are kept near the low base rate with slight elevation for lung and skin due to YES1/SRC-family signaling.
